headline: Spent $25k less, kept the profit: best Friday NP in eight weeks
commentary:
### The day
- Best day of the month: **$14,184 NP**, margin nearly double last Friday's.
  - NP: $14,184 v $10,193 last Fri
  - NM: 27.5% v 14.0%
  - Cost: $37,323 v $62,453
- Top of the eight-Friday range on profit, bottom end on spend.
  - Eight-Friday NP average: $8,136
  - Previous best Friday: $10,193
  - Eight-Friday cost average: $43,559
- November keeps pulling away from October across the same days.
  - MTD NP: $92,320 v $68,422
  - MTD margin: 17.2% v 14.5%
### What drove it
- Revenue fell under a third, spend fell forty percent. That's the day.
  - True commission: $51,507 v $72,646
  - Search cost: $28,984 v $55,359
- Search bought **half the clicks**, paid more for them, sold them better.
  - Search CPC: $12.00 v $10.96
  - Search EPL: $30.85 v $24.95
  - Impression share: 10.0% v 12.5%
- Every ping tree beat its seven-day rate, so the value was broad.
  - Direct (Inc ZP) EPL: $23.62 v $19.57 last7
  - Direct Lenders: $27.49 v $20.34
  - Test tree: $19.16 v $17.53
- Blended EPL flat though, and PMAX and Demand Gen both turned small profits.
  - Blended EPL: $17.87 v $17.73 last Fri
  - Eight-Friday EPL range: $15.32–$17.97
  - PMAX NP: $430 v $147
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 13/11 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Speed | Bids walked down | $2,654 | $2,414 | — |
| Scavengers | Low-CPC catch-all | $896 | $2,387 | — |
- Speed held its spend while the rest of Search halved.
  - Speed CPC: $15.17 v $15.09
  - Speed cost: $2,654 v $2,414
- Scavengers barely showed up — impression share gone in both big ones.
  - Amount scavenger: under 0.1% v 16.7%
  - Payday alternative scavenger: under 0.1% v 21.0%
watch: fastloanadvance.com is new money in our auctions — 31% impression share on speed terms, from under 10% a week ago.
Bing ran a small loss on the day, $4,605 spend against $4,441 commission, against a 13.3% margin month to date.
Two light buying days in a row on Search — whether 10% impression share holds or clicks come back towards the 5,000 we had last Friday.
